'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
**[[2024 Lebanon pager explosions]]
***Nine people are killed and over 2,750 others are injured, including [[civilian]]s, [[Hezbollah]] members, and the [[List of diplomatic missions of Iran|Iranian ambassador]] to [[Lebanon]], when their [[booby trap]]ped [[pager]]s [[explode]] in Lebanon and [[Syria]]. Hezbollah accuses [[Israel]] of perpetrating the attacks. [https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-hezbollah-israel-exploding-pagers-8893a09816410959b6fe94aec124461b (AP)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/lebanese-authorities-raise-death-toll-in-pager-blasts-to-11-say-4000-injured/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/17/dozens-of-hezbollah-members-wounded-after-pagers-explode-in-lebanon (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/09/17/world/middleeast/israel-hezbollah-pagers-explosives.html (''The New York Times'')]
**Three Hezbollah militants are killed and two others are injured in [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on [[Blida, Lebanon|Blida]] in [[southern Lebanon|southern]] Lebanon. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/17/israels-war-on-gaza-live-38-killed-as-israel-risks-becoming-pariah?update=3184187 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[artillery]] targets the town of [[Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Komyshuvakha]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing two people and injuring five others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-russian-shelling-ukraines-southeastern-zaporizhzhia-region-governor-2024-09-17/ (Reuters)]
**[[Doctors Without Borders]] halts its operations in [[Russia]] after [[Government of Russia|its government]] removed the organization from its roster of [[Russian undesirable organizations law|approved foreign charities]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/17/doctors-without-borders-halts-russian-operations (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**A poll by the [[Palestinian Center for Policy and Survey Research]] finds that, for the first time during the war, a majority of the residents of [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] does not support [[Hamas]]' [[2023 Hamas-led attack on Israel|invasion of Israel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-poll-finds-big-drop-support-oct-7-attack-2024-09-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ituri conflict]]
**[[CODECO]] militants kill ten [[civilian]]s in an overnight attack on a [[Hema people|Hema]] village in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. Some of the victims were [[Decapitation|beheaded]], according to local authorities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/militia-kills-10-civilians-eastern-congo-2024-09-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[2024 Bamako attacks]]
***[[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin|JNIM]] gunmen [[Mass shooting|open fire]] on a [[military camp]] in [[Bamako]], [[Mali]], killing a number of [[Malian Armed Forces|soldiers]]. The perpetrators tried to infiltrate the camp, and also opened fire on the [[Modibo Keita International Airport]]. At least 15 suspects are arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-explosions-training-camp-attack-472f06bd7d2d9d2913252e9787f276f9 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Central European floods]]
***Four people are found dead after [[flood]]s in [[Austria]], while another is killed in [[Poland]], bringing the death toll from the ongoing floods in [[Central Europe|Central]] and [[Eastern Europe]] to 21. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/17/storm-boris-death-toll-rises-flooding-new-areas-on-alert (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/16/storm-boris-death-toll-rises-as-floods-continue-to-ravage-central-europe (Al Jazeera 2)]
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Typhoon Yagi]] in [[Myanmar]] increases to 236 people, with more than 77 people still missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/17/at-least-two-hundred-thirty-six-killed-in-myanmar-flooding-from-typhoon-yagi (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Portugal wildfires]]
**Three [[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[firefighter]]s die while fighting [[wildfire]]s in the country's [[Central Region, Portugal|central]] and [[North Region, Portugal|northern]] [[regions of Portugal|regions]], bringing the death toll from the wildfires to seven people. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/death-toll-climbs-four-portugal-battles-wildfires-2024-09-17/ (Reuters)]
*At least 25 children are killed in [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]], when a bus carrying [[Islam in Nigeria|Muslims]] celebrating [[Mawlid]] [[traffic collision|crashes]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/09/17/nigeria-bus-crash-kills-at-least-25-children-on-religious-trip (Al Arabiya)]
*Six people are killed in a [[landslide]] caused by heavy rains in [[Naucalpan]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-state-landslide-deaths-climate-rainy-season-f6b8b874e48f5fbf03ec0e586e76fae4 (AP)]

**The [[Government of Afghanistan|Taliban government]] reopens the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] [[embassy]] in [[Muscat]], [[Oman]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/afghanistan-reopens-embassy-oman-taliban-113753485 (ABC News)]

**[[Ekattorer Ghatak Dalal Nirmul Committee]] President [[Shahriar Kabir]] is arrested in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], on [[criminal charge|charges]] of [[crimes against humanity]], [[mass killing]], and [[murder]] for his involvement with [[Sheikh Hasina]]'s government during the quota reform movement. *[[LGBT rights in Georgia (country)|LGBT rights in Georgia]]
**The [[Parliament of Georgia]] approves a law on "family values and the protection of minors" that would restrict [[LGBTQ+]] rights in [[Georgia (country)|the country]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/georgias-parliament-approves-anti-lgtbq-bill/a-70239544 (DW)]
*[[Mazan rapes]]
**Dominique Pélicot, the 71-year-old man accused of drugging his wife to sleep and recruiting dozens of men to [[rape in France|rape]] her for more than ten years, admits to all of the charges against him in his first testimony since the trial opened on September 2. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2kdd3n7yqo (BBC News)]
